frontmatter_snapshot.summary: EKM's heavy-tail-probability mechanism for fat tails via maxima: the only non-degenerate limit laws for affinely-normalized sample maxima c_n⁻¹(M_n − d_n) are the three max-stable extreme-value types — Fréchet Φ_α, Weibull Ψ_α, Gumbel Λ — unified by the GEV shape parameter ξ, per Embrechts, Klüppelberg & Mikosch (1997) Ch.3.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Fisher-Tippett-Gnedenko Theorem and the Three Extreme-Value Types
